sources.title: Pony Diffusion V6 XL - V6 (start with this one) - Civitai
sources.snippet: Pony Diffusion V6 is a versatile SDXL finetune capable of producing stunning SFW and NSFW visuals of various anthro, feral, or humanoids species and their interactions based on simple natural language prompts.

sources.title: Pony V7 - PurpleSmartAI
sources.snippet: Pony V7 is a powerful, unconstrained foundational model built for character-centric image generation. It excels in creating high-quality visuals across diverse artistic styles—from stylized illustrations and fantasy creatures to anthropomorphic beings and cartoon characters—all through intuitive natural language prompts.
